purpose: Freeze an outcome-blind, period-disjoint context inventory and 6/15/27 split before questions, prompts, model outputs, labels, detector scores, or new metrics are created.

candidate_policy.candidate_source: Only the 50 observed complete periods that passed every frozen family-eligibility rule in the local feasibility proof.

assignment.family_assignment_policy: Create 16 slots for each allowed family, order slots and eligible periods by domain-separated seeded SHA-256, and retain the deterministic full matching only after all 48 slots are filled.
assignment.split_assignment_policy: Within each family, order the 16 assigned contexts by an independent domain-separated seeded SHA-256 key; assign the first 2 to protocol_pilot, the next 5 to development, and the final 9 to confirmation.
assignment.tie_break_policy: Break any equal hash keys by the canonical slot identifier or ISO period start string.
assignment.reserve_policy: Retain the two unmatched observed complete periods as source reserve. Do not substitute them after model outcomes are viewed.

context_evidence_policy.canonical_record_definition: The normalized eight-field canonical record definition from the historical-overlap proof.
context_evidence_policy.inventory_hash_definition: Domain-separated SHA-256 over the sorted multiset of canonical row fingerprints and their multiplicities.
context_evidence_policy.net_revenue_reconciliation_by_period: All is_valid_net_revenue_line rows in the assigned complete week.
context_evidence_policy.product_return_rate_comparison: All is_merchandise_net_revenue_line rows for products that pass the frozen weekly product-support rules.
context_evidence_policy.country_product_exposure: All is_merchandise_net_revenue_line rows for countries that pass the frozen weekly country-support rules, excluding Unspecified.
context_evidence_policy.final_question_evidence_payload_check: Pending until deterministic question templates and gold evidence payloads are defined at the next execution gate.
